I enjoy sharing applied bioinformatics lessons with clinical, regulatory, and engineering teams. Here are a few recent engagements.

## Bioinformatics Projects

### MRD analytics for gynecologic oncology
`March 2024 | `

- Presented platelet RNA-seq classifiers and tumor-informed ctDNA MRD workflows that support real-time decision-making for ovarian cancer trials.
- Highlighted lessons on cohort design, assay sensitivity, and explainable ML for translational research teams.


## Machine Learning Projects

### Pathogen intelligence system for COVID-19
`2020 | GrandOmics Biosciences`

- Built a Galaxy-based infrastructure for mutation tracking, lineage analysis, and metagenomic detection that was shared with epidemiology teams across China.
- Conducted virtual workshops so public-health collaborators could customize dashboards and standardized reports.

### Open-source knowledge sharing
`Ongoing`

- Publish reproducible notebooks showcasing WDL/Cromwell, Galaxy, and Python/R best practices for MRD, MSI, and pathogen surveillance projects.
- Participate in GitHub and ResearchGate discussions focused on sequencing QC, workflow automation, and translational ML.
